ATS users and recruiters

The Truto Unified ATS API provides a single normalized interface for reading and writing applicant tracking system data across 27 ATS providers including Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Ashby, Teamtailor, BambooHR, Jobvite, and more. Covers the full recruiting lifecycle with 17 unified resources. All data is accessed in real-time via pass-through to the underlying ATS. Schema can be customized using JSONata mappings.
